claims.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations to correctly decode the Gray code. Replacing XOR with OR in the second bit conversion will cause incorrect binary values to be generated, leading to wrong Gray code outputs after increment and conversion back to Gray.
claims.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value, 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation using XOR operations

claims.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion requires XOR operations for correct decoding. Using AND instead of XOR for the LSB conversion will produce incorrect binary values, causing subsequent Gray code outputs to be wrong.
claims.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value, 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation using XOR operations

claims.violated_requirement: MSB of binary output should directly copy MSB of Gray input. Using wrong bit index (gray_wire[2] instead of gray_wire[3]) will cause incorrect binary values and subsequent wrong Gray code outputs.
claims.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value, 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation

claims.violated_requirement: Binary value should increment by 1 every two clock cycles. Changing increment to add 0 will cause the counter to stay at its initial value, breaking the Gray code sequence generation.
claims.spec_basis: The counter increments every two clock cycles
